aggregation.setup: Explicit native cell/node occupancy flags; no MPs/time integration. 1m grid; occupied fragment [1,2]x[1,2], full support [10,11]x[1,2], empty gap 8m.
aggregation.interpretation: Native fallback chooses a disconnected full cell. Native locate/assemble produces cross-gap extrapolation; rows preserve unit translation but tie fragment motion to remote support. This does not establish how often the accepted collapse triggers this condition.

fbar.setup: 6x6m 2D native GIMP mesh, h=1m; one MP (2.9,2.7), domain .8x.8, initial F=I and V=.64. All nodes active; prescribed ux=.02*x*y, uy=-.01*x*y. Native calculate-strain-rate-disp, update-strain-kirchoff, update-domain-det; no stress/material response or time integration.
fbar.interpretation: Fbar stores strain-modified F while physical volume uses unmodified increment. Domain-area update follows stored F. Different Jacobians may be an intentional Fbar convention, but volume/domain/stress consistency needs a documented and validated contract. This diagnostic does not quantify accepted-run error.
